content.title: How to watch 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards: Time, channel, free live stream
content.text: If you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.The 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards return tonight, spotlighting the most‑played artists and songs across iHeartRadio platforms from the past year while previewing expected 2026 hits.Now in its 13th year, the show will broadcast live from the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles on Fox.Cord-cutters can watch the ceremony live and on demand via Fubo (free trial), DIRECTV (free trial) and other streaming services listed below.What time do the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards start?The 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards air live on Thursday, March 26, from 8 to 10 p.m. ET on Fox. How to watch the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards for freeViewers without cable or an over-the-air antenna can watch the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards live using free trials from streaming services that carry Fox, such as Fubo and DIRECTV. These trials allow viewers to stream the ceremony at no cost. Cancel anytime.Sling also carries Fox in select markets and offers a one-day pass for a one-time payment of $4.99. No commitment, no auto-renewal.Table not scrollableComparing streaming servicesFubo - Fubo offers one of the widest selections of channels among live TV streaming services. Now, Sling adds even more value with passes that let you stream live TV without a subscription: just $4.99 for a day, $9.99 for the weekend or $14.99 for a full week. These one-time payments are perfect if you just want to watch a single show, live game or special event. No commitment, no auto-renewal, just affordable access when you need it.Sling$4.99Stream the 2026 iHeart Radio Music Awards for only $4.99 with Sling's one-day pass.Claim OfferWith so many streaming platforms and ever-changing subscription prices, it’s always worth checking the latest free trials and promo deals to make sure you’re getting the best value when tuning in.Who is hosting the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards?Ludacris is hosting the 2026 ceremony. In addition to emceeing the night, he will perform and also receive the 2026 iHeartRadio Landmark Award, recognizing the cultural impact of his decades‑long career across music and film.Who is performing?This year’s performance lineup includes Alex Warren, Lainey Wilson, Ludacris, RAYE, Kehlani, John Mellencamp and the first‑ever joint performance from TLC, Salt‑N‑Pepa and En Vogue. Mellencamp will also be honored with the 2026 iHeartRadio Icon Award.Who is nominated?Taylor Swift leads all artists with nine nominations, including Song of the Year, Pop Song of the Year, Best Lyrics, Best Music Video, Artist of the Year, Pop Artist of the Year, Favorite On Screen, Favorite Tour Style and Favorite TikTok Dance. Other artists with multiple nominations include Alex Warren, Bad Bunny, Benson Boone, BLACKPINK, Chris Brown, Ed Sheeran, Ella Langley, GloRilla, Grupo Frontera, Jelly Roll, JENNIE, j-hope, KATSEYE, Kendrick Lamar, Lady Gaga, Linkin Park, LISA, Mariah the Scientist, MOLIY, Morgan Wallen, RAYE, Sabrina Carpenter, Shinedown, SZA, Tate McRae, Twenty One Pilots and Zara Larsson.Fan‑voted categories return as well, including Favorite Broadway Debut, Favorite TikTok Dance, Favorite Debut Album, Best Lyrics, Best Music Video, Favorite On Screen, Favorite Tour Photographer, Favorite Soundtrack, Favorite Tour Style, Favorite Tour Tradition and Favorite K‑pop Collab.Who is making special appearances?The show will feature appearances by Alysa Liu, Ne‑Yo, Nicole Scherzinger, Nikki Glaser, Sombr, Weezer and others. Taylor Swift will also be making her first awards‑show appearance of the year.What special honors are being presented?John Mellencamp will receive the 2026 iHeartRadio Icon Award, honored for his decades of work as a singer‑songwriter and advocate for causes such as Farm Aid.Ludacris will receive the 2026 iHeartRadio Landmark Award, recognizing his influence on hip‑hop and culture across multiple decades.Miley Cyrus will be honored with the 2026 iHeartRadio Innovator Award for her artistic evolution and extensive humanitarian work.Alex Warren will receive the 2026 iHeartRadio Breakthrough Artist of the Year Award following his record‑breaking chart success in 2025.‘The Real Housewives of Rhode Island’ premieres tonight: How to watch for freeNew evidence in John Wilkes Booth case to be revealed on ‘Expedition Files’ Season 4 tonightNew ‘Survivor 50′ Episode 6 airs tonight: Where to watch for free‘The Valley’ returns for Season 3 premiere tonight: How to watch for freeHow to secure Lily Allen presale tickets for fall tour dates before they sell outThis article was produced with assistance from AI tools and reviewed by Syracuse.com staff.
